pages.text: The sun slips low over the farm. Pip the puppy has one last job to do.
"Goodnight, hens," says Pip. The hens tuck their heads under their wings.
"Goodnight, cow," says Pip. The cow lies down in the sweet soft hay.
"Goodnight, pig," says Pip. The pig snuggles into the mud with a happy sigh.
"Goodnight, sheep." One sheep, two sheep, three sheep, all curled up close.
"Goodnight, horse," says Pip. The horse gives a soft, sleepy snort.
"Goodnight, ducks." The ducks float home across the still, quiet pond.
"Goodnight, tractor," says Pip. The tractor is asleep already.
The farmhouse lights go on, one, two, three.
The moon comes up big and round over the barn.
Pip pads home and curls into his basket.
"Goodnight, farm," whispers Pip. And the farm says goodnight back.
